capabilities.name: Book a doctor's appointment
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find a free slot with a doctor and book it for you?

US.note: Since August 2026 Zocdoc is a connected app in Google Gemini: you say what care you need, see real open slots, and book an in-person or video visit, with the last step on Zocdoc's screen.

evidence.title: New connected apps are coming to Gemini (book a doctor's appointment with Zocdoc)
Zocdoc and Google Bring Real-Time Healthcare Appointment Booking to Gemini

GB.note: Rapid Health's AI Smart Triage inside the NHS App asks about your symptoms and books a GP slot straight away, but only at the practices that use it (about 200 practices and networks, over 1 million patients), not across the NHS.

evidence.title: 24/7 GP appointment booking is now live in the NHS App for more than one million patients
How do I use the NHS app? (the NHS App sends you to Smart Triage to book)

DE.note: Doctolib's AI phone assistant takes patient calls at any hour and books straight into the practice calendar, but only at practices that pay for it, with no public count; Doctolib has no patient-side booking agent, and no AI booking was found on the public 116117 service.

evidence.title: Doctolib führt KI-basierten Telefonassistenten ein

IN.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found: Practo, Apollo 24|7, Tata 1mg and Eka Care book through ordinary apps, and only vendor marketing and an old Apollo Alexa skill turned up (searched October 2026).

BR.note: Doctoralia's Noa Booking agent was still in development in May 2025 with no launch found since, and the SUS WhatsApp pilot only confirms or moves visits, with no AI named.

evidence.title: Doctoralia optimiza la gestión sanitaria con Noa, su asistente impulsado por la IA de Microsoft
SUS ganha marcação de consultas pelo WhatsApp; como vai funcionar e quando começa?

MX.note: IMSS appointments go through the IMSS Digital app, the website or the phone; its first AI assistant is planned for doctors, not patients, and Doctoralia's Noa Booking agent has not launched here.

evidence.title: El IMSS planea aplicar inteligencia artificial en su expediente clínico electrónico

CL.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found at FONASA, Hospital Digital or Doctoralia (searched October 2026; thin Spanish-language search).

evidence.title: Doctoralia optimiza la gestión sanitaria con Noa, su asistente impulsado por la IA de Microsoft

CO.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found at the EPS insurers or Doctoralia; EPS Sanitas's WhatsApp assistant books visits, but no source says it is AI (searched October 2026).

evidence.title: Doctoralia optimiza la gestión sanitaria con Noa, su asistente impulsado por la IA de Microsoft

capabilities.name: Renew or order a prescription
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent renew or order your prescription medicine for you?

US.note: Amazon's Health AI, in the One Medical app and since March 2026 on Amazon.com, sends your renewal request to a One Medical provider and the medicine is filled at Amazon Pharmacy or another pharmacy; in a one-year Utah pilot, Doctronic's AI renews some chronic-condition prescriptions on its own.

evidence.title: Amazon's Health AI agent (One Medical)
Utah is experimenting with a new role for AI: renewing prescriptions

GB.note: You can order repeat prescriptions in the NHS App, but no AI agent can do it for you, and no Boots agent was found.

evidence.title: Prescriptions in the NHS App

DE.note: E-prescriptions (e-Rezept) are redeemed with the health card, the gematik app or a printout, with no route for an agent; no AI ordering was found at DocMorris or Shop Apotheke.

evidence.title: E-Rezept

IN.note: PharmEasy's AI voice agent calls past buyers to remind them to reorder and sends a WhatsApp link, but you finish the order yourself; no AI ordering was found at Apollo 24|7, Tata 1mg or Netmeds.

evidence.title: How PharmEasy Improved Medicine Reorder Conversion with Ringg

BR.note: RD Saúde (Drogasil and Raia) runs AI agents mostly for staff and call centres, and lists a pharmacist agent only as a future idea; no agent that orders prescription medicine was found.

evidence.title: RD Saúde e IA agêntica

MX.note: Farmacias del Ahorro uses Gemini Enterprise mainly for staff work, and nothing was found at Farmacias Guadalajara; no agent that orders prescription medicine was found.

evidence.title: Farmacias del Ahorro se sube a la ola de la IA y busca ahorrar 100,000 horas de trabajo al año

CL.note: No AI ordering was found at Cruz Verde, Salcobrand or Farmacias Ahumada; Recemed's WhatsApp assistant lets doctors write e-prescriptions, but patients cannot order through it.

evidence.title: Recetas médicas electrónicas disponibles por WhatsApp

CO.note: No AI agent that orders prescription medicine was found at Cruz Verde Colombia or other chains (searched October 2026).

capabilities.name: Check your health cover or a claim
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent check what your own health plan covers, or the status of your claim, for you?

US.note: UnitedHealthcare's Avery, in the UHC app and on myuhc.com since March 2026, answers from your own plan: benefits, coverage, claim status, cost estimates and balances.

evidence.title: UnitedHealthcare Introduces AI Companion Empowering People with Simpler Navigation, Personal Experience

GB.note: NHS care is free at the point of use, and no live AI assistant that checks your cover or a claim was found at Bupa, AXA Health or Vitality; their claims run through ordinary app and web forms.

DE.note: Barmer's chatbot answers general questions and AOK Plus uses AI voice agents to route calls, but none looks up your own cover or files a claim; the TK app lists no AI assistant.

evidence.title: AOK Plus: KI-Agenten automatisieren Kundendienst in EU-Cloud

IN.note: ICICI Lombard's AI voice agent tells customers the status of their own health claims (launched 2022), and in August 2026 the insurer said bots and a WhatsApp chatbot handle about 70% of inbound calls; no recent source names claim status, and no other insurer was confirmed.

evidence.title: ICICI Lombard and Skit.ai partner to launch an AI-powered digital voice agent to track claim status
How ICICI Lombard is using AI-driven tech to boost efficiencies

BR.note: SulAmérica's virtual assistant answers common questions, including about refunds, but no source says it checks or files your own; no AI assistant was found for SUS.

evidence.title: SulAmérica adota Inteligência Artificial e reduz em 90% tempo médio de atendimento

MX.note: IMSS shows your coverage in the IMSS Digital app with no AI, and its planned AI assistant is for doctors; no AI tool was found at GNP or AXA Mexico.

evidence.title: El IMSS planea aplicar inteligencia artificial en su expediente clínico electrónico

CL.note: FONASA's Mi Fonasa virtual branch and the Isapres Colmena, Banmédica and Consalud handle refunds and certificates in ordinary apps, with no AI assistant found (searched October 2026).

CO.note: Famisanar's WhatsApp assistant Camila handles your own medical authorizations, but no source says it is AI; nothing was found at Sura, Nueva EPS or ADRES.

evidence.title: Cómo pedir virtualmente autorizaciones, incapacidades y certificaciones en Famisanar
